riders.note: One more needle, to a maximum of fifteen.

description.value:
Trigger You hit a creature with an unarmed Strike.

You add one needle to that creature, to a maximum of 15. Target it before you use this action; the needle lands on whoever you have targeted.

At 5 needles it is enfeebled 1. At 10 it is blinded. At 14 it is stunned 2 and its Strikes lose all runes. All three happen by themselves, once each, as the count passes them — see @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Effect: Scarlet Needle], which is where the count lives.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Scorpio — the Needle]. Needles are counted on each creature separately and last until the encounter ends.
